A two-handed weapon (or abbreviated as 2H-sword/mace/axe) is a weapon that requires both the main hand and off-hand slots in use (as opposed to one-handed using one slot). Two-handed weaponry includes swords, maces, axes, staves and polearms. Generally two-handed weapons are slower than their one-handed counterparts, but make up for it with stronger stats. Guns, bows and crossbows also occupies the off hand slot when equipped.

Twin Spire Ruins are the remains of a holy draenei site in Zangarmarsh now contested by the Alliance and Horde. Two towers flank a burial ground, with the towers being capturable. When both towers are captured by a faction, their battle standards are carried forth and placed in the graveyard, giving complete control. Despite the name, the ruins contain only one ruined tower in the center. The "twin spires" are two small buildings that are not spire-like.

Typeless refers to a dispel type without any classification. Those effects are normally physically inflicted, but not necessarily. Typeless effects are typically caused by bosses, rogues, and warriors. Apart from some exceptions (for example, hunter auras), they only exist as debuffs (which cannot be removed by the bearer), however, they can also have positive effects (and as such act like buffs). Typeless effects cannot be dispelled by normal dispels. Only special items, such as a Luffa, can remove specific effects. See: :Category:Buffs & :Category:Debuffs.

Twink rotating is a complex method for twinks to run battlegrounds with regular players that have their experience turned on. It requires at lease two separate accounts, each having a twink. With one twink, you would queue for a battleground and join. Once the battleground is filled, you would then queue for that specific battleground with your second twink. You then play the battleground normally with your first twink. Before your team captures the enemy flag, you leave the battleground. This in turn, makes a slot open for your second twink to join. Tyr's Fall (or Tirisfal in the vrykul tongue) is a craterous lake found within the Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades, for which it is the namesake. As the name suggests, it was the place where the titan keeper Tyr made his final stand against the C'Thrax generals Zakajz and Kith'ix. Under the lake lies a tomb, the final resting place of Tyr, which collapsed. The tomb and the surrounding area have been guarded by a secretive group of paladins known as the Tyr's Guard for thousands of years.

The Tyr's Guard is a secret order of paladins sworn to protect the tomb in Tyr's Fall and The Silver Hand (artifact). Originally an order of vrykul dedicated to protecting Tyr's body for eternity, they were replaced upon their death by their human descendants, who carried out their secret mission for centuries. However, even after they became paladins following the Second War, the Tyr's Guard was decimated by the undead Scourge during the Third War, but the survivors continued to carry out their duty under the leadership of a paladin named Travard. Twisted Currents are mercury elementals located in Stormsong Valley.
The Twisted Child of Rezan is a skeletal devilsaur located in the Lair of Rezan in Zuldazar while the world quest Twisted Child of Rezan (quest) is active. __NOTOC__
The Twitching Eyeball is a quest reward from His Eye Upon You.

Twitter integration was a game feature that allowed a player to connect their World of Warcraft account to their Twitter account to post tweets about obtaining or higher quality items, earning an achievement or taking a screenshot. It was announced on 7 February 2023 that it will be removed in an upcoming update. It was fully removed on 9 February 2023.

Twinbraid's Patrol is a small dwarven camp led by General Twinbraid in the Southern Barrens. As its name indicates, it is a rest stop under the shade of a tree for Twinbraid, his bodyguards and Hurlston Stonesthrow. As the patrol was away from Bael'dun Keep, it survived the destruction of the base at Bael Modan, leading Twinbraid into a fit of vengeance against the nearby Horde-affiliated Frazzlecraz Motherlode.

Two Sides to Every Tale is awarded for completing Alliance and Horde storylines up to Tides of Vengeance including: #A Nation United - The Alliance storyline for Kul Tiras #Zandalar Forever! (achievement) - The Horde storyline for Zandalar #Tides of Vengeance (achievement) (Alliance) - The Alliance War Campaign up to Dead Reckoning #Tides of Vengeance (achievement) (Horde) - The Horde War Campaign up to The Return of Derek Proudmoore Completing the achievement unlocks the Bloodflank Charger for Horde characters and the Ironclad Frostclaw for Alliance characters.

Twisted Appendage was a tentacle summoned by the corruption effect of the same name. When procced, it Mind Flayed the player's target for 10 seconds.
